notes: Toxic and infect are told apart. INFECT stays a kind: its damage is poison instead of life. TOXIC is new: a combat hit that gives N poison as well
the hit page's BURN and TOXIC are a pair -- one or the other, since toxic only counts combat damage
with TOXIC lit the amount row is two dials, the hit and the poison; the knob turns the one you touched last, and the button reads HIT 4  TOXIC 1
TOXIC works with DAMAGE, COMMANDER and INFECT, LIFELINK and the spreads; it takes the monarch like any combat hit, UNDO takes the poison back too, and history marks it with a drop
RPG window: a TOXIC box under LIFELINK, its N on the HOW MUCH window, poison bubbles and +N POISON on the battle stage; a long battle line now scrolls instead of covering the heroes
BASIC at a table: the turn ring sits at the edge of the glass, and the opponent panels move up to meet it
a Life Link that drops out of range no longer plays itself the winner's fanfare for a moment when only an OUT seat is still in touch
